name: anker
description: Anker — a spaced-repetition flashcard app for learning German, with Claude & Codex agents that manage your decks over MCP.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/hub && tsc -p packages/app && tsc -p packages/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @anker/app && npm run build -w @anker/hub && npm run build -w @anker/desktop
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run dist -w @anker/desktop
scripts.build:android: npm run build -w @anker/app && cd packages/app && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.hub: npm run build -w @anker/app && npm run build -w @anker/hub && node packages/hub/dist/cli.cjs
